g.text: Memory strip (top) — one glyph per address cell; glyph
valid green / invalid red / gap grey
Loaded panel — one slot per artifact
(none) dim = not loaded · [u] unload one · [U] unload all
Data Sections (left pane) — one row per contiguous range
green row = valid · red = invalid · █░░░░░░░ 8-cell bar =
... N more ranges (see log) ... = over 200 · MAC
Hex view (center pane) — Search ASCII / Goto 0xADDR drive
